audience: field service and inspection teams who collect mobile forms with GoCanvas

useCases.title: List our forms and their fields
useCases.text: Lists the forms the user can see with name, status and version, and opens one form to see its screens and fields.

useCases.title: Find submissions and read their answers
useCases.text: Lists completed forms for a form or user, opens a submission with all its responses, and shows who changed it and when.

useCases.title: List field users and their departments
useCases.text: Lists the company's users with name, email and enabled flag, the departments, and the users in a department with their role.

useCases.title: Check the dispatches sent to field workers
useCases.text: Lists dispatches for a user, department or form with assignee, status and schedule, and opens one with its pre-filled responses.

useCases.title: Dispatch a form to a field worker
useCases.text: Creates a dispatch of a form for a user with a schedule, so it appears on the worker's mobile device. It can be sent at once.

useCases.title: Check where field users were
useCases.text: Lists GPS location events of one user or all users for a period of up to 7 days. This needs the tracker feature.
